name: Sweden
sub: Packaging sorted by material, plus food waste, general waste and the recycling centre.

banana.w: Food waste becomes biogas and fertiliser. Use your kommun's paper bag.

eggshell.w: Shells go in food waste along with other kitchen scraps.

coffee.w: Grounds and paper filters both go in food waste.

bones.w: Bones count as food waste and go to biogas.

shampoo.w: Rinse it and put the cap back on. It's plastic packaging.

polybag.w: Soft plastic bags are plastic packaging here, though many other countries refuse them in recycling.

chips.w: Crisp packets are plastic film with a thin metal layer. Plastic packaging.

tube.w: Squeeze it empty. Tubes go with plastic packaging, even ones with a metal layer.

carton.w: Milk cartons go in paper packaging despite the thin plastic layer. Rinse and flatten.

eggtray.w: Moulded pulp is paper packaging. Some kommuner also take it in food waste.

box.w: Flatten boxes so they don't fill the container with air.

pizza.w: Remove leftovers. A greasy box still goes in paper packaging.

jar.w: Empty and rinse. Put the metal lid in metal packaging.

wine.w: Glass bottles go in glass packaging. Sort clear and coloured glass if your station splits them.

perfume.w: Perfume bottles are glass packaging. Remove the pump if you can.

tin.w: Rinse it. Tins and lids go in metal packaging.

window.w: Window glass melts at a different temperature from bottles, so one pane can spoil a batch. Take it to the recycling centre.

drinkglass.w: Drinking glasses aren't packaging glass. Their additives spoil bottle glass. Small amounts go in general waste; more to the recycling centre.

mirror.w: Mirrors aren't glass packaging. Take them to the recycling centre.

tissue.w: Fibres are too short and soiled to recycle. Many kommuner take them in food waste; others want general waste.

diaper.w: Diapers go in general waste and are burned for energy.

pad.w: Wrap it and put it in general waste. Never flush it.

battery.w: Use the battery box in a shop or the recycling centre. Batteries in general waste start truck fires.

bulb.w: CFL bulbs contain mercury. Hand them in at the recycling centre.

paint.w: Leftover paint is hazardous waste. An empty, dry can could go in metal packaging instead.

toy.w: The plastic bin is for packaging only. A toy is a product, so it goes to general waste or the recycling centre.
